name: organiseur-personnel
description: PWA personnelle iPhone, socle technique S5

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --base=/organiseur-personnel/ && npm run build:sw && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('manifest.webmanifest','dist/manifest.webmanifest')"
scripts.test:core: tsc --strict --target ES2022 --module commonjs --lib ES2022,DOM --outDir .tmp-tests src/domain/types.ts src/domain/dates.ts src/features/decor.ts src/features/activities.ts src/features/habits.ts src/features/day.ts tests/domain.test.ts tests/activities.test.ts tests/navigation.test.ts tests/monthlyReview.test.ts tests/storage.test.ts
scripts.build:sw: tsc --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck --rootDir src --outDir dist src/pwa/service-worker.ts && node -e "require('node:fs').renameSync('dist/pwa/service-worker.js','dist/service-worker.js')"
